relationships.subject: Yoda1
relationships.evidence_quote: Yoda1 was discovered after screening several million compounds and validated as a selective Piezo1 agonist not acting on related Piezo2 channels

relationships.subject: ischemic stroke
relationships.evidence_quote: Our data revealed enhanced spiking activity after activation of mechanosensitive Piezo1 channels in trigeminal afferents of the IL hemi-skulls of the ischemic stroke group, as well as prolonged activation of nociceptive TRPV1 channels.

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 channels were continuously active during the entire 10 min of capsaicin (1 µM) application in the IL hemi-skulls of the ischemic stroke group

key_findings: Cortical photothrombotic stroke increased Yoda1-evoked Piezo1 and capsaicin-evoked TRPV1 firing in ipsilateral meningeal afferents.
Meningeal afferents showed higher maximal spike frequency at baseline after stroke.
